what.text: This page follows refugees from Burkina Faso living in the United States, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 1575 Burkinabe refugees in the United States, 0.4% of all refugees from Burkina Faso.
Mali hosts the most Burkinabe refugees, followed by Côte d'Ivoire, Togo and Ghana.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Burkina Faso with JNIM in every year from 2018 to 2025.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in Burkina Faso from 2019 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1997 at 11 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 1647, at the end of 2024; the main years of displacement in the data are 2014 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the United States.
These are year-end totals for the United States only, reported to UNHCR.
